headline: Council to consider $29,500 police chief search contract, 2026-2027 grants, and an ordinance adding a Sealer of Weights and Measures position.
summary: The council will review a contract for a police chief executive search, several grant acceptances, two open meeting law complaints, and resolutions and an ordinance on city positions and policies.
items: Consideration of appointment: Marylin Murphy to Council on Aging
Presentation: Veterans Service Officer 90 Days in Review
Mayor's Report
CAFO Report: update on Searles Estate expenses and revenues (Req. of Clr. Soto)
CAFO Report: status on outstanding back taxes and recovery (Req. of Clr. Drew)
Request: cost breakdown and tonnage fees for Methuen Housing Authority trash collection (Req. of Chair Soto)
Request: clarification on school contracts through city legal department and delays (Req. of Chair Soto)
Request: City Solicitor and DPW to create website roadmap for acceptance of unaccepted ways (Req. of Clr. Valley)

Request: Buildings Audit RFP status update (Req. of Clr. Drew)

Request: HHSI Permit Fees Review status update (Req. of Clr. Drew)
Request: 2026 Paving Program status, including completed and remaining streets (Req. of Clr. Drew)
Request: Constellations Program financial and performance update (Req. of Clr. Drew)
Request: Trash and Recycling Collection performance and FY2028 contractor transition update (Req. of Clr. Drew)
Request: Automated License Plate Reader (ALPR)/FLOCK replacement system status and privacy update (Req. of Clr. Drew)
Request: Permanent Police Chief Search status and timeline (Req. of Clr. Drew)

Resolution TR-26-90: joint resolution calling for reopening federal investigation into corruption involving former Methuen Police Department leadership (Requested by Mayor Beauregard and Councilor Simard)

l - Request for Update on Searles Estate Expenses & 
Revenues (Req. of Clr. Soto)
l - Status on outstanding back taxes and recovery to date. 
This was asked in the beginning of the year what 
progress has been made in collections (Req. of Clr. 
Drew)
12. Requests of Councilors
n - Clarification on the cost breakdown and tonnage 
fees for the Methuen Housing Authority trash collection 
services through the city ’s municipal trash contract. 
(Req. of Chair Soto)  
n - Clarification on why the school contracts have to go 
through the city’s legal department and what is the 
reason(s) for the delay in processing (Req. of Chair Soto) 
n - Request to the City Solicitor and the DPW to develop 
a dedicated section on the City's website providing 
residents with a clear, step -by-step roadmap for the 
acceptance of unaccepted ways. The section should 
include an overview of the process from beginning to 
end, an online application or petition form, eligibility 
requirements and supporting documentation, any 
applicable fees, betterment assessments or other costs, 
estimated timelines, and contact information. (Req. of 
Clr. Valley)

costs mentioned by the Mayor on the Echo Lane sewer 
connection project. (Req. of Clr. Valley)

Drew)

Rollout and Implementation Update (Req. of Clr. Drew)

during FY2027 Budget Workshop) (Req. of Clr. Drew) 
n - 2026 Paving Program – Streets Complete, Remaining 
Streets, Spring 2027 List, and Anticipated Completion 
Before Winter (Req. of Clr. Drew) 
n - Constellations Program – Financial and Performance 
Update (Req. of Clr. Drew) 
n - Trash and Recycling Collection– Current Service 
Performance, Missed Pickups, and FY2028 Contractor 
Transition Update (Req. of Clr. Drew) 
n - Automated License Plate Reader (ALPR) / FLOCK 
Replacement System– Status and Privacy/Data Policy 
Update (Req. of Clr. Drew) 
n - Permanent Police Chief Search – Status, Process and 
Anticipated Timeline (Req. of Clr. Drew) 
n - Update on barrel fees: Is anyone sending emails out, 
and if there is no response, are we following up with a 
phone call? (Req. of Clr. DiZoglio)
13. Public Service: 
A. Grants: None
B. Licenses: None
C. Contract(s):
- C-27-39 Blue Integrity Consulting, LLC,16 Forest Front Street 
#207, Salem, MA 01970 for Executive search to conduct a 
comprehensive recruitment process for the position of the 
Chief of Police, for the Methuen Police Department in the 
Amount of $29,500.00
14. Other Officers and Committee Reports 
15. Unfinished Business
Resolution(s): 
- TR-26-89 – Resolution to amend TR-13-8 – Resolution 
providing for annual performance evaluations: City Council 
Employees (Request of Chair Soto)
- TR-26-90 – A Joint Resolution of the Mayor and City Council 
of the City of Methuen Calling for the Reopening of the 
Federal Investigation into Corruption Involving the Former 
Leadership of the Methuen Police Department (Requested by 
Mayor Beauregard and Councilor Simard)
- TR-26-92 – A Resolution Accepting a Gift of 9/11 Memorial 
Banners (Sponsored by Clr. Ryan DiZoglio)
Ordinance(s): 
- TO-26-21 - An Ordinance Amending the Wage and Salary 
Classification Plan, Unaffiliated, to add the new position of 
Sealer of Weights and Measurers
16. New Business:
 Open Meeting Law Complaint – Dated September 9, 2026
Open Meeting Law Complaint– Dated September 29, 2026
Resolution(s): 
- TR-26-93 A Resolution Authorizing Acceptance of a Fiscal 
Year 2025 Bulletproof Vest Partnership Program Award 
$27,999.02(Request of Mayor Beauregard) VIEW BACKUP
- TR-26-94 A Resolution Authorizing Acceptance of a 
$48,759.90 Commonwealth of Massachusetts Fiscal year 2027 
Federal Municipal Road Safety Grant (Request of Mayor 
Beauregard) VIEW BACKUP
- TR-26-95 Resolution Accepting a Gift of Equipment from 
Planet Fitness to the Fire Department  
Ordinance(s): 
17. Any Other Business for the Good and Welfare of the 
Community
18. Adjourn
Neily Soto
Chair of the City Council
